paragraphs.text: Rashka , called Rashka the Slayer , was a formidable archer who swore revenge against Baron Sengir . Her family members were, in fact, on the ship that the Baron hijacked to populate his Dark Barony and became prisoners and slaves of the Baron. She knew that the only way to free them was to slay Sengir, and she was in training for most of her life, fighting and killing the vampires in Aysen and An-Havva .

During development, Rashka the Slayer was a green card. Later, it was moved to white. It is strongly implied that Rashka was the champion long-awaited by Autumn Willow , which could help her with her dilemma.
